summary: An opt-in, content-free TUI DEBUG log traces conversation freshness from subscription frames through held entries, adaptation, documents and pane follow state

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: The Rust feed Conversation update now includes its subscription ID; wire and stored formats are unchanged. Conversation display behavior is unchanged.

manual.detail: Optional diagnostics use FRACTAL_TUI_FRESHNESS=1 and FRACTAL_TUI_FRESHNESS_LOG as documented in the troubleshooting guide.

recovery.detail: Unset the diagnostic environment variables to stop logging. No stored conversation data changes.
